dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY-based screen/linkage layout typical of ORCA subsystems.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical insurance receipt billing system - system management information settings for medical institution/disaster injury classification and special device consumption tax handling
purpose.summary: ORCGW13 is a screen-handling subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It manages system administration settings related to medical institution information (W13 screen), including injury/disaster classification, point calculation categories, tax classifications, and special device lists. It is called as a linked subprogram receiving screen areas and SPA (Scratchpad Area) via LINKAGE SECTION.

notable_features: 54 COPY statements for screen layouts and shared data structures
LINKAGE SECTION with SCRAREA covering W01-W30 and other screen copybooks
SPA (Scratchpad Area) pattern typical of ORCA online screen programs
PIC S9(9) BINARY for row indices (no COMP-3 usage)
OCCURS tables for classification lists (RSIIRYOKBN, TENKBN, TAXKBN, SKJKBN, KIZAITAXKBN, KOTEIKBN)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 110711 bytes (2737 lines). The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt software maintained by JMA. Program follows ORCA conventions with MCP (Message Control Program) linkage pattern.
